scope: Finite MCSP[0,0] negative control at m=3 inner inputs and N=8 truth-table bits only.

model.cost: Every gate counts, including NOT. Constants 0/1 and positive raw inputs are free.
model.zero_gate_realizations: One of Fin 5 free output wires: three positive raw inputs, constant false, constant true.
model.bit_address_convention: Bit a of the integer encoding is f(a); coordinate zero is the least-significant bit of the inner assignment.

outer_network.representation: Explicit topologically ordered List Gate, not an accepting-set predicate.
outer_network.term_structure: Five 8-literal equality terms, each with seven AND2 gates; eight shared input NOTs; four OR2s merge the terms.
outer_network.interpreter: Initialize input bits plus false/true; fold through gates, evaluating NOT/AND2/OR2 from already-stored indices and appending each result; return wire 56.
outer_network.out_of_bounds_note: The interpreter is total with false as an index fallback; network_well_formed proves that fallback cannot arise for the specified circuit.

source.proof_method: Constructive finite Decidable instances; of_decide_eq_true rfl checked by Lean kernel; propositional deductions for isolation and certificates.

parent.validation: Parsed every explicit Lean gate and compared with membership_classifier(3). Parent code was read with bytecode writing disabled, not edited.

well_formed_gate_indices.result: Every gate reads only previous wires; output wire is in range.

47_gates.result: Explicit network list length is 47; this is a construction count, not a lower bound.

zero_gate_inner_class.result: For every x : Fin 256, selecting a free zero-gate inner wire realizes x iff x is 0,255,170,204,240.

classifier_semantics.result: For every x : Fin 256, the actual gate-list interpreter returns true iff x belongs to the specified five-element set.

mcsp_zero_equivalence.result: Actual network acceptance iff the table has a zero-gate inner realization in the stated free-wire model.

one_bit_encoding.result: The bounded flip is exactly xor with 2^i, without modular wrap.

one_bit_semantics.result: Flipping i negates exactly bit i and preserves all other bits, for all 256 tables and all eight addresses.

isolated_accepting_set.result: Every one-bit neighbor of each of the five YES tables is outside the YES set.

actual_network_neighbor_rejection.result: For any network-accepted table and each of eight addresses, the actual network rejects the one-bit neighbor.

proper_masks_have_missing_bit.result: Every Fin 256 coordinate mask except 255 has an unfixed address.

witness_agrees_on_fixed_bits.result: Flipping an unfixed address preserves all bits required by the coordinate-fixing mask.

no_proper_yes_certificate.result: At each network-accepted table, no mask other than 255 is a YES certificate: a rejected neighbor agrees on all fixed coordinates.

coverage.note: Coverage follows from universally quantified Lean theorems. The certificate result is proved through an unfixed-bit neighbor witness, not by assuming a certificate minimum.

trust_audit.limitation: Not literally axiom-free: standard propext remains in ordinary Lean/Std definitions and matching/finite-decision proof dependencies. No new axioms are declared. No Classical.choice, Quot.sound, sorryAx, or native-reduction axiom occurs in any of the final queried theorems.

limitations: Finite zero-threshold MCSP[0,0] control only; not the growing-beta OPS target.
47 gates counts this actual outer construction. No general circuit-size minimality claim is proved.
The general-family O(N log N) argument remains manual and is not formalized here.
The inner zero-gate model is explicitly selection of a raw-input/constant free wire; no theory of nonzero inner circuit size is developed.
The final proof has the standard propext dependency; therefore the stronger reading of no axioms whatsoever is not achieved.

reproduction.notes: Only the installed pinned Lean distribution and Std are required. No Lake build, cache update, external dependency, or parent experiment execution is required to check the Lean proof.
